events.title: 에리크 캉토나 returnsto Selhurst Park for the first time since his flying kick the previous year, scoring twice as 맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 윔블던 4–2 to keep their title hopes alive. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are still nine points ahead with a game in hand, beating 셰필드 웬즈데이 2–0 at home. 리버풀 are confined to third place after a goalless draw at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼. 애스턴 빌라 go fourth win a 3–0 home win over Leeds.
Gavin Peacock scores a hat-trick in 첼시's 5–0 win against 미들즈브러.
밀월 manager 믹 매카시 is appointed manager of the Republic of Ireland team, some 18 months after the end of his playing career for the national side.
울버햄프턴 원더러스 reserve midfielder Jimmy Kelly , 22, is jailed for five years for manslaughter following his part in a fight outside a 리버풀 hotel in September 1994, in which a 26-year-old man died.
Logi Ólafsson makes his debut as the manager of Iceland with a 1–7 loss against Slovenia .

The Department of Employment denies work permits to Marc Hottiger (who agreed to move from 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 to 에버턴) and Ilie Dumitrescu (who agreed to move from 토트넘 홋스퍼 to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 ). Both clubs are set to appeal the decisions. 크리스털 팰리스, 16th in Division One, appoint Dave Bassett manager, ending 스티브 코펠 's brief second spell as manager.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 pay a club record £6.7million for 파르마 and Colombia striker Faustino Asprilla , on the same day that they beat 미들즈브러 2–1 at the Riverside Stadium. 맨체스터 유나이티드 keep up the pressure with a goal from Lee Sharpe and a series of spectacular saves from 페테르 슈마이켈 giving them a 1–0 home win over 블랙번 로버스.
Former 리버풀 manager 밥 페이즐리 dies at 77 after several years of suffering from Alzheimer's disease . 에버턴 surrender their defence of the FA Cup with a fourth-round replay defeat by 포트 베일 .

미들즈브러 lose 4–1 at home to a resurgent 볼턴 원더러스, while QPR also give their survival hopes a boost with a 3–1 win at 셰필드 웬즈데이. In Division One, new 크리스털 팰리스 manager Dave Bassett oversees a 4–0 home win over bottom club 왓퍼드 which gives his side's hopes of reaching the playoffs a major boost. In the FA Cup third round, a Manchester derby at Old Trafford sees City take an early lead through Uwe Rosler before 에리크 캉토나 scores a quick equaliser from the penalty spot, with Lee Sharpe finally getting the winning goal for the hosts.

Glenn Roeder is sacked after nearly three years as manager of 왓퍼드. Away from the Division One relegation battle, 크리스털 팰리스 home in on the playoff places with a 3–2 win at Tranmere, who are now in the bottom half of the table after spending much of the first half of the season in the top six.

The title race takes an unexpected turn when 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 lose 2–0 at 웨스트햄 유나이티드, allowing 맨체스터 유나이티드 to cut their lead to six points with a 2–0 home win over 에버턴, although 케빈 키건's men still have a game in hand.
Former 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and England manager 그레이엄 테일러 is appointed manager of 왓퍼드 for the second time.

맨체스터 시티 hold 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 to a 3–3 draw at Maine Road , meaning that the Premier League leaders still have a seven-point lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드 but no longer have the advantage of a game in hand. 리버풀 remain in contention for the title, beating 블랙번 로버스 3–2 at Ewood Park .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드's lead is cut to four points when 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 볼턴 원더러스 6–0 at Burnden Park , which also gives 알렉스 퍼거슨's team a major boost to their goal difference.

스윈던 타운 and 허더즈필드 타운 , the last remaining non-Premier League teams in the FA Cup, are defeated in fifth-round replays. 리버풀 announce that 이언 러시 will be leaving on a free transfer at the end of the season.
